name: K-C Hendersonville Nonwovens Plant (Berkeley Mill) - Hendersonville NC
type: Nonwovens manufacturing plant (materials for Depend, Poise, U by Kotex)

fieldNotes.location: Roster lat/lng (35.318728,-82.460953, APPROXIMATE) landed in downtown Hendersonville - wrong. Web research (PR Newswire, Henderson County EDP, Yelp) gave 32 Smyth Ave (the historic Balfour Mills / Berkeley Mill site). Satellite confirmed a large nonwovens manufacturing plant ~3 km NW of downtown. Locked center 35.34630,-82.46880.
fieldNotes.truckGate: A dedicated K-C wayfinding sign on the public access road reads 'Kimberly-Clark - TRUCK ENTRANCE - 1/4 MILE NORTH - DOCKS 1-6'. The whole property is enclosed by a continuous chain-link perimeter fence; the truck entrance is a controlled, signed gate on the internal access road set well back from public roads.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No guard booth could be directly photographed - the truck entrance gate is behind a wood/grass buffer that Street View on public roads does not reach. Marked false (no booth seen); flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Gate present, no guard shack observed - set true (likely kiosk / badge check-in). Flagged uncertain since the gate itself was not directly imaged.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Estimated ~36 across multiple building faces - dock banks with trailers backed in on the SW (Docks 1-6 area) and on the building's NE face. Banded 25-50; exact count uncertain due to building size.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Very large drop-yard operation - multiple gravel/paved lots with hundreds of parked trailers in organized rows (NE lot, south lot, SW lot). ~240 trailers visible, capacity ~320. Banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Clear dedicated trailer-storage lots, distinct from active dock staging.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Long internal access road from the signed truck entrance to the docks - easily holds a 3+ truck queue.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide internal access roads and large open paved yard - ample room for an express/bypass lane.
fieldNotes.railServed: A rail spur runs into the property on the SW side - rail cars/boxcars observed parked adjacent to the trailer yard alongside the rail corridor.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Dock activity is split between the SW building face ('Docks 1-6') and the building's NE face, suggesting separate shipping/receiving clusters - moderate confidence, flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town industrial site ~3 km NW of small-town Hendersonville, surrounded by woods, grassland and scattered residential - Rural per rubric.
fieldNotes.buildingCount: One very large interconnected manufacturing complex plus minor support structures - counted as 3 distinct buildings.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~78 acres for the fenced property including the building, drop yards, rail siding, parking and grass buffer.
